notes.title: Some Small Updates, and a Thank You!
notes.content:
Thank you to all of the new players! Getting a bump up in traffic after a few years has surely been unexpected!

A few small changes for this patch:
[list]
[*] Re-added the Desktop "Fail" menu instead of the mobile one.
[*] My Unity Game Engine Plus Subscription ran out as I've moved away from this engine, and Unity removed that entire tier, so unfortunately I had to add the Splash Screen back.
[/list]

notes.title: Some small changes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the save bug where if you reset your save and finished a level, you couldn't move until you went back to the settings menu or closed the game.
[*] Fixed a few level-specific collision bugs.
[*] Some small visual optimizations, reducing triangle counts on most of the meshes.
[*] Slight visual changes to make the different types of block more distinct from each other (especially near the end of the game).
[/olist]

notes.content:
